notes: Mostly repairs. Lyrics now arrive for far more tracks — the online lookup was giving up before it asked whenever a file had no per-track artist. Volume levelling actually runs for the first time. Importing a record you already have no longer adds a second copy, and multi-disc albums keep their discs. When a record finishes the case now closes itself and puts you back on the wall. You can remove several albums at once from the shelf list, the tracklist shows marks for the tracks you come back to, and the crate rail is now the main way to cross the wall.
